profile.headline: Enterprise Architect & Software Engineer
profile.summary: Innovative engineering leader with a proven track record specializing in cloud architecture, streaming applications, and generative AI. Experienced in aligning engineering teams cross functionally and leading complex multi-domain initiatives to successful completion. Adept in mentorship, delivering impactful solutions that align with business objectives, and languages such as Python, Go, and Rust.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with internal clients in managing and implementing technology drives and initiatives.
• Designed programs & software that monitor and analyze company performance and key reporting metrics.
• Developed, designed, and maintained applications and websites using Linux Bash Scripting, Javascript, HTML, CSS, PHP, Shopify, R, Python, Java, SWIFT, and XML.
• Responsible for ensuring internal clients use latest technology. Worked and set up business deals with outside vendors 
• Responsible for cyber security including firewall configurations and encryption. Engaged in penetration testing using Kali Linux to test for security weaknesses and exploits.
• Engaged in scripted economic site selection work using various APIs and python code.

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Analytics and Information Management
positions.description:
• Worked with Finance, Business, and IT clients to establish requirements for and design of Business Intelligence and Enterprise Performance solutions including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting & analytics
• Developed and programmed numerous data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, and visual reporting applications and scripts mainly using python, SQL, HTML, R, and javascript
• Developed financial and operational models and analytical reports to support strategic initiatives
• Analyzed complex financial information and reports to provide accurate and timely financial recommendations to clients for decision making purposes
• Supported the client FP&A function with data collection, report generation, variance analysis, and data quality monitoring
• Rapidly prototyped and communicated solutions to demonstrate possibilities to new clients
• Developed dashboards and analytical reports

positions.title: Insurance Risk Analyst
positions.description:
•	Managed the insurance risk accounts of a dozen globally recognized oil and gas companies 
•	Analyzed commercial contractor insurance policies to ensure client risk tolerance thresholds were met for onsite work.
•	Analyzed and verified issuing insurance underwriter financial strength and size.
•       Used compliance and legal verbiage in analyzing and verifying submitted insurance documents. These insurance documents included policy documents, declaration pages, Accord Forms, alternate employer endorsements, waiver of subrogation endorsements, additional insured endorsements, and monopolistic state worker compensation policies.
•        Extensive experience in verifying and analyzing energy and marine related insurance documents and policies.

positions.title: Economic Research Analyst
positions.description:
•	Built financial and economic forecast models and presentations for various business projects and organizations, including an international business incubator and the City of Austin. 
•	Created economic development studies to assist local, state, and national governments and organizations maximize economic growth potential.
•	Formulated economic impact studies which measured the general relevance of business and political decisions, and the financial and economic impact on various organizations and communities.

positions.title: Loan Officer
positions.description:
•	Communicated daily with the Wells Fargo banking team about products that were new and upcoming and then developed daily plans of action to sell and push these products.
•	Created books of business and compiled contact information to be later used in communicating with clients.
•	Managed consumer and business depository and credit accounts, and issued various credit and depository products.

projects.title: YahooFinancials Python Module
projects.description:
A Python 2/3 module I developed and pushed to PyPi.org that handles Yahoo Finance stock data extraction. The module returns both financial statement and technical stock data for a list of inputted companies. I wrote yahoofinancials as a replacement for the older yahoo-finance module developed by Łukasz Banasiak that stopped working after Yahoo discontinued it's old API. My solution was to scrape, hash out, and clean the necessary financial data for use in the module from the Yahoo Finance React.js webapp's client side data store.

The code is up for review on my Github:
https://github.com/JECSand/yahoofinancials

The module is freely available for easy install/use via pip:
$ pip install yahoofinancials

projects.title: The Middle Class and Debt Over Time in America
projects.description: An analysis of real income changes, cost of living changes, quality of employment changes, and debt changes for the middle class from the years 1980 through 2011. Raw data was obtained from the University of Minnesota and the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis databases. Data was modeled and statistically analyzed using Stata. Households with an income of less than $5,000 or more than $250,000 in 2011 real dollars were dropped from the set to control for outliers.
